visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three people, two men and one woman, stand in a bright indoor area with glass doors behind them. The woman on the right holds the camera, smiling while wearing glasses and a pink shirt. The man in the middle wears a grey cap, glasses, and a pink shirt over a floral tee, gesturing with a thumbs up. The man on the left wears a white polo and holds a white skincare box. (2) The camera zooms in on the white box, specifically the ingredient list. The woman’s fingers point to text mentioning 'Vitamin B3, B5, Peptides'. The background is slightly blurred, focusing on the product packaging. (3) The scene shifts back to the group. The man in the cap talks animatedly, moving his hands to explain. The woman laughs, covering her mouth with her hand. The lighting is bright and even. Yellow and white variety-style text overlays appear frequently. (4) The woman is now in a retail setting with shelves full of skincare products labeled 'SKINCEUTICALS'. She holds a phone showing a digital clock. The man in the cap continues his explanation in the foreground. Profile photos of two doctors with labels appear as overlays on the screen. (5) A final static screen appears with a white background and grey brushstroke textures. It displays the 'DRX' logo, social media handles, phone numbers, and addresses for the clinic locations in Sanchong and Zhongshan. English and Chinese text for 'contact us' is visible.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Slogan]: 大來賓! 彭賢禮醫師. [Subtitle]: 大家好. (2) [Subtitle]: 在高雄的有名的. [Variety]: 在這:D. (3) [Subtitle]: 禮貌呢? 我不能講老前輩. [Variety]: 愛開玩笑a莊. (4) [Subtitle]: 資深前輩. 怎麼可以提到老這個字呢!! (5) [Variety]: (前輩很認真!). [Subtitle]: 其實你看它這裡面寫的幾個組成成分. (6) [Subtitle]: 維生素B3、B5、胜肽. (7) [Subtitle]: 我覺得可能只有胜肽可以抗老. 沒辦法啦! 為什麼沒辦法? (8) [Subtitle]: 因為它顆粒這麼大, 而且它沒辦法吸收進去啊. 所以我們皮膚科醫生對於這些有的沒的成分真的是很講究的! (9) [Subtitle]: 我們很講究因為!! 東西要能夠進到皮膚裡面去!! 就是有兩個品牌很像, 一個是杜克. (10) [Subtitle]: 另外一個就是現在很流行的修麗可. 最早其實是 Dr. Pinnell. [Variety]: #杜克 #修麗可. (11) [Subtitle]: 杜克大學皮膚科醫師. 他也是品牌創始人. 但是他的配方是找藥劑博士 Dr. Omar. (12) [Subtitle]: 後來他們兩個有點鬧掰了... 很類似的配方. (13) [Logo]: DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Slogan]: 歡迎聯繫我們 contact us.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female host (Doctor), 1 male guest doctor (Dr. Peng), and 1 male colleague assisting with the product.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The female host wears glasses and a pink button-down shirt. The guest, Dr. Peng, wears a grey flat cap, glasses, and a pink shirt over a white shirt with a floral pattern.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in a bright, modern lobby with a glass entrance. Later, it moves into a skincare retail pharmacy with glass shelving displaying many blue and white bottles of SkinCeuticals products.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, greeting the audience. A bright, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM with a steady 4/4 drum beat plays at a moderate volume. (2) A male voice enters with a calm, friendly, and professional tone. The female host reacts with laughter, creating a playful atmosphere. The BGM remains consistent. (3) A sharp 'pop' sound effect coincides with the visual transition to the product close-up. The male voice becomes more clinical, pronouncing 'Vitamin B3, B5, and Peptides' in clear English. The female host asks a question with rising intonation. (4) As the male guest explains molecular absorption, his speech rate is moderate and well-articulated. There's a subtle 'ding' sound effect used for emphasis during the brand name mention. (5) The final phase features a swell in the music's volume as the host concludes, followed by a quick fade out as the outro screen appears.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Expert Introduction -> Product Ingredient Analysis -> Scientific Explanation -> Brand History -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the efficacy of skincare ingredients, specifically peptides and their absorption capabilities, while introducing a prominent guest dermatologist, Dr. Peng, to provide professional authority. It also clarifies the history and relationship between specific skincare brands.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the MIAMO and SkinCeuticals products, filming inside a branded retail environment, and specific brand mentions in the dialogue and subtitles.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production value social media clip with dense text overlays and professional experts. The pacing is designed for rapid information consumption common in dermatology influencer content.
